lines.text: He has broken my strength on the way;
He has cut short my days.
I say: “O my God, do not take me in the midst of my days!
Your years go on through all generations.
In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth,
and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
They will perish, but You remain;
they will all wear out like a garment.
Like clothing You will change them,
and they will be passed on.
and Your years will never end.
The children of Your servants will dwell securely,
and their descendants will be established before You.”

pictures.scene: Raphael, Christ Falling on the Way to Calvary — Christ down on the road under the cross with His mother reaching toward Him, He has broken my strength on the way
pictures.name: pd_raphael_kracht

pictures.scene: Thomas Cole, The Voyage of Life: Manhood — the man in the storm-tossed boat with his hands clasped in prayer and the angel in the clouds above, O my God do not take me in the midst of my days
pictures.name: pd_cole_midden

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, Looking Down Yosemite Valley — the granite walls of the valley standing in the light of early morning, in the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_grondslagen

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, Shoes — a pair of boots worn right through and thrown down on the floor, they will all wear out like a garment
pictures.name: pd_gogh_kleed

pictures.scene: El Greco, Saint Martin and the Beggar — the cloak cut in two and handed down from the saddle to the man on the road, like clothing You will change them and they will be passed on
pictures.name: pd_greco_verwisselen

pictures.scene: Hans Memling, Christ Giving His Blessing — Christ looking straight out of the panel with His hand raised in blessing, but You remain the same and Your years will never end
pictures.name: pd_memling_dezelfde

pictures.scene: Albert Anker, The de Bary Children — the children standing quietly together in their own house, the children of Your servants will dwell securely
pictures.name: pd_anker_kinderen
